4

📋 Copy Your Config Values (MOST IMPORTANT!)

After clicking "Register app", you'll see a screen with your Firebase configuration. This is the most important step!

You'll see something like this:

console.firebase.google.com/project/lovelink-app

Here's your Firebase configuration

// Copy ALL of this ↓↓↓ const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: "AIzaSyBxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", authDomain: "lovelink-app.firebaseapp.com", projectId: "lovelink-app", storageBucket: "lovelink-app.appspot.com", messagingSenderId: "123456789012", appId: "1:123456789012:web:abc123def456ghi" };
COPY ALL 6 VALUES! You need every single one. Don't skip any.

Here's what each value means:

Value Name What it looks like Where it goes in .env
apiKey AIzaSyB... (long string) VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
authDomain your-project.firebaseapp.com VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
projectId your-project (short name) VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
storageBucket your-project.appspot.com VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
messagingSenderId 123456789012 (12 digits) VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
appId 1:123456:web:abc123 VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
Can't find this screen later? Go to: Firebase Console → ⚙️ Settings (gear icon, top left) → "General" tab → scroll down to "Your apps" section → click your web app → you'll see the config there.

Click "Next" and then "Continue to console" when done.

7

📝 Create Your .env File

Now take the 6 values you copied in Step 4 and create a file called .env in your project's root folder.

The .env file should look exactly like this:

# Firebase Configuration # Replace the values below with YOUR values from Step 4 VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=AIzaSyBxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=lovelink-app.firebaseapp.com VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=lovelink-app VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=lovelink-app.appspot.com VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=123456789012 VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:123456789012:web:abc123def456ghi
Important rules:
  • Each variable MUST start with VITE_
  • No spaces around the = sign
  • No quotes around the values
  • One variable per line

How to create the .env file:

Method How
VS Code Right-click project folder → New File → type .env → paste the content
Terminal (Mac/Linux) nano .env → paste content → Ctrl+X → Y → Enter
Terminal (Windows) notepad .env → paste content → Save
Any text editor Create a new file, save it as .env (with the dot!) in the project root
Where is the "project root"? It's the folder that contains package.json, src/, and other project files.
8

🚀 Deploy to Vercel

Now push your code to GitHub and deploy on Vercel.

8.1 Push to GitHub:

# In your terminal, inside the project folder: git init git add . git commit -m "Initial commit - LoveLink app" git branch -M main git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/lovelink-app.git git push -u origin main

8.2 Deploy on Vercel:

  1. Go to vercel.com → Sign in with GitHub
  2. Click "Add New..." → "Project"
  3. Find your repository → Click "Import"
  4. Framework Preset: "Other" (Vercel auto-detects Vite)
  5. Click "Deploy"

8.3 ⚠️ Add Environment Variables on Vercel:

Before or after deploying, you MUST add your Firebase config to Vercel:

Vercel Dashboard → Your Project → Settings → Environment Variables

VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY = AIzaSyB...
VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN = lovelink-app.firebaseapp.com
VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID = lovelink-app

... (add all 6 variables)

After adding environment variables, you must redeploy: Go to Deployments tab → click "..." on latest deployment → "Redeploy"
9

🔒 Set Production Security Rules (Final Step)

Once everything works, secure your Firestore database:

  1. Go to Firebase Console → Firestore Database
  2. Click the "Rules" tab (top of the page)
  3. Delete everything in the editor
  4. Paste this code:
rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { // Users can only access their own data match /users/{userId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId; } // Anyone logged in can read couple codes match /coupleCodes/{code} { allow read: if request.auth != null; allow create: if request.auth != null; allow update: if request.auth != null; } // Chat messages - only logged-in users match /chats/{chatId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; } // Call signaling - only logged-in users match /calls/{callId} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; } } }

Click "Publish"

🎉 YOU'RE DONE! Your LoveLink app is now fully set up and deployed!
?

🆘 Troubleshooting

Problem Solution
"Permission denied" error Check Firestore is in test mode, or update security rules
Login doesn't work Make sure Email/Password is enabled in Authentication → Sign-in method
"Invalid API key" error Double-check your .env values match exactly what Firebase gave you
App works locally but not on Vercel Make sure you added all 6 env variables in Vercel AND redeployed
Can't find config values Firebase Console → ⚙️ Settings → General → scroll to "Your apps"
Video call doesn't work Make sure you're on HTTPS (Vercel provides this automatically). Allow camera/mic permissions.
"App not authorized" error In Firebase Auth → Settings → add your Vercel domain to "Authorized domains"

Adding Vercel domain to Firebase:

  1. Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings
  2. Scroll to "Authorized domains"
  3. Click "Add domain"
  4. Enter your Vercel URL (e.g., lovelink-app.vercel.app)
  5. Click "Add"
✓
